# Semrush

> Semrush is a digital marketing platform for growing and measuring brand visibility across SEO, PPC, content, social, local, and AI search.

Semrush provides integrated tools for keyword research, competitive analysis, site auditing, backlink intelligence, advertising research, content optimization, social media management, local marketing, and reporting. Its ecosystem includes product documentation, APIs, apps, free tools, training, and enterprise solutions.

## Platform

- [Semrush Home](https://www.semrush.com/): Main platform overview for SEO, PPC, social, content, local, and AI search visibility.
- [Semrush One](https://www.semrush.com/one/): Unified platform positioning for winning visibility across traditional and AI-powered search.
- [Features](https://www.semrush.com/features/): Overview of Semrush product capabilities, toolsets, and marketing workflows.
- [Pricing](https://www.semrush.com/prices/): Plans and pricing for Semrush subscriptions and core tool access.
- [App Center](https://www.semrush.com/apps/): Marketplace of add-on apps and integrations built around Semrush workflows.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://enterprise.semrush.com/): Enterprise-grade solutions for large brands, agencies, and advanced marketing teams.

## SEO & Competitive Research

- [SEO Toolkit](https://www.semrush.com/seo/): Overview of Semrush SEO tools for audits, rankings, keywords, and competitors.
- [Domain Overview](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/overview/): Competitive intelligence for domains, traffic trends, and search visibility benchmarks.
- [Keyword Overview](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/keywordoverview/): Keyword metrics including volume, intent, difficulty, and SERP analysis.
- [Organic Research](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/organic/overview/): Analyze competitors’ organic rankings, pages, and keyword positions.
- [Keyword Gap](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/keywordgap/): Compare keyword profiles across domains to find missed opportunities.
- [Position Tracking](https://www.semrush.com/position-tracking/): Monitor keyword rankings across locations, devices, and search engines.
- [Site Audit](https://www.semrush.com/siteaudit/): Crawl websites to detect technical SEO issues and prioritize fixes.
- [On Page SEO Checker](https://www.semrush.com/on-page-seo-checker/): Get page-level optimization ideas based on competitors and ranking factors.

## Backlinks & Link Building

- [Backlink Analytics](https://www.semrush.com/backlinks/analytics/): Explore backlink profiles, referring domains, anchors, and authority signals.
- [Backlink Audit](https://www.semrush.com/backlink_audit/): Audit toxic links and manage backlink cleanup workflows.
- [Link Building Tool](https://www.semrush.com/link-building/): Discover outreach prospects and manage link acquisition campaigns.
- [Bulk Analysis](https://www.semrush.com/bulk-analysis/): Compare multiple domains for backlink and authority metrics at scale.
- [Authority Score Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/website-authority-checker/): Free tool for checking Semrush authority metrics for a domain.

## Advertising & PPC

- [Advertising Toolkit](https://www.semrush.com/advertising/): Overview of Semrush tools for paid search and competitor ad research.
- [Advertising Research](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/advertising/overview/): Analyze competitors’ paid keywords, ad copy, and traffic trends.
- [PLA Research](https://www.semrush.com/analytics/pla/overview/): Research competitors’ product listing ads and shopping campaign activity.
- [AdClarity](https://www.semrush.com/adclarity/): Display advertising intelligence across advertisers, publishers, and creatives.
- [PPC Keyword Tool](https://www.semrush.com/ppc-keyword-tool/): Build, organize, and optimize keyword lists for paid campaigns.
- [Ads Launch Assistant](https://www.semrush.com/apps/ads-launch-assistant/): App for creating and launching Google Ads campaigns with Semrush data.

## Content, AI & Social

- [Content Marketing Toolkit](https://www.semrush.com/content-marketing/): Tools for content ideation, optimization, writing, and performance measurement.
- [Topic Research](https://www.semrush.com/topic-research/): Generate content ideas, subtopics, and questions around a target theme.
- [SEO Writing Assistant](https://www.semrush.com/seo-writing-assistant/): Improve content readability, SEO alignment, and originality while writing.
- [ContentShake AI](https://www.semrush.com/apps/contentshake-ai/): AI-assisted content creation app for ideation, drafting, and optimization.
- [Social Toolkit](https://www.semrush.com/social-media/): Manage social publishing, tracking, and competitor analysis from one place.
- [Social Poster](https://www.semrush.com/social-media/social-poster/): Schedule and publish social content across connected profiles.
- [Social Tracker](https://www.semrush.com/social-media/social-tracker/): Monitor competitors’ social activity and engagement performance.

## Local & Listings

- [Local](https://www.semrush.com/local/): Local marketing tools for listings, reviews, and map visibility.
- [Listing Management](https://www.semrush.com/listing-management/): Distribute and maintain business information across directories and platforms.
- [Review Management](https://www.semrush.com/review-management/): Monitor, respond to, and analyze customer reviews from one dashboard.
- [Map Rank Tracker](https://www.semrush.com/map-rank-tracker/): Track local map rankings across target areas and keywords.
- [Local Heatmap](https://www.semrush.com/local-heatmap/): Visualize local ranking performance across a geographic grid.

## Free Tools

- [Free Tools Hub](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/): Directory of free Semrush tools for SEO, content, and website analysis.
- [Keyword Magic Tool](https://www.semrush.com/features/keyword-magic-tool/): Discover keyword ideas, groups, and search intent opportunities.
- [Keyword Difficulty Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/keyword-difficulty-checker/): Free checker for estimating how hard a keyword is to rank for.
- [Backlink Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/backlink-checker/): Free backlink lookup for domains and URLs.
- [Website Traffic Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/website-traffic-checker/): Estimate website traffic and engagement metrics for any domain.
- [SERP Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/serp-checker/): Inspect search results pages for a keyword and location.
- [Web Site SEO Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/website-seo-checker/): Run a quick SEO health check for a website.
- [Local Rank Checker](https://www.semrush.com/free-tools/local-rank-checker/): Check local search rankings for a business and keyword.
